name: mcp-business
description: Stripe (OAuth), n8n workflow automation, PostHog product analytics and Google Analytics 4 reporting.

n8n_api_url.title: n8n URL
n8n_api_url.description: Your n8n instance URL, e.g. https://n8n.example.com. Leave empty for docs-only mode.

n8n_api_key.title: n8n API key
n8n_api_key.description: n8n > Settings > n8n API > Create key. Optional: without it n8n-mcp still serves node docs and validation.

posthog_api_key.title: PostHog personal API key
posthog_api_key.description: PostHog > Settings > Personal API keys (phx_...). Leave empty if unused.

ga_credentials_file.title: Google credentials JSON
ga_credentials_file.description: Application Default Credentials file (gcloud auth application-default login --scopes ...analytics.readonly). Leave empty if unused.
